members.name: FromBraces
members.signature: public static List<CodeFoldRange> FromBraces(string[] lines, ICodeLexer? lexer, CancellationToken ct)

docs.summary: Folds every brace pair spanning more than one line, every #region to its #endregion, and runs of three or more line comments or using directives. Braces inside strings and comments are skipped by lexing.
